milestones.description: Uses inventory_has to check that the player has obtained white_wool (min_count=1). Shearing a white sheep drops 1-3 white_wool items into the player's inventory. This is preferred because the wool appearing in inventory is the direct, reliable outcome of successfully shearing the sheep. The player starts with no wool, so any white_wool in inventory confirms the shearing occurred.

Uses inventory_has to check that the player has obtained red_wool (min_count=1). Crafting red_wool requires combining white_wool + red_dye in a crafting grid (works in both 2x2 personal grid and 3x3 crafting table). The player starts with no red_wool, so any red_wool in inventory confirms the crafting was completed. This is preferred because crafted items end up in inventory and the player has no red_wool at episode start.
